s1.desc: a snowy hilltop landscape under a bright sky with drifting white clouds

s2.desc: a snowy picnic spot with a checkered blanket spread out under a bright sky

spans.view: with the gentle curve of the snowy hill behind them

beats.text: Pax waddles a few steps to the left carrying a picnic basket while blindfolded Polly holds his fin and shuffles along beside him
Pax stops and sets the picnic basket down on the snow while Polly waits beside him
Pax pulls a rolled checkered blanket out of the basket and lifts it up
Pax holds the rolled blanket in front of him and starts to unroll it next to Polly

spans.notes: keep12 is low because the leads fill most of the edges and move; hill line and ice patches overlap exactly (compare 0/26, 0/52), only the clouds drift
Pax holding the blanket up to his chest, then flinging it up; 8 frames before the blanket wipe
blanket wipe: the flung blanket sweeps across the picture into the picnic shot; last wipe edge visible at f76

spans.view: with plates of sandwiches and cookies, a glass jug and two glasses of lemonade with straws in the foreground

beats.text: Polly stands blindfolded with both fins raised behind her head, untying the blindfold
Polly pulls the blindfold off her eyes with her eyes still closed
Polly opens her eyes and stares at the food spread out in front of her, holding the blindfold in one fin
Polly beams with blushing cheeks as little sparkles pop up around her head

spans.notes: tilt down starts at f112 (compare 109/111 locked, 110/112 doubled grid lines); clouds drift slightly
tilt down from Polly to the food and the open basket
food and basket insert; the basket holds the plush bouquet with small Pax and Polly plush figures (a lead copy too)
dissolve (match cut) from the full spread to the half-eaten spread
half-eaten food insert, no lead, 8 frames
tilt up from the food to Pax and Polly sitting on the blanket

Pax and Polly sitting on the blanket, but the plush bouquet with small Pax and Polly plush figures sits in the foreground the whole time; also a slow camera drift (compare 222/250, 221/274: blanket grid lines doubled)
dissolve to the Icebreakers card pack
product shot of the Icebreakers card game; the top card flies at the viewer with blur
fade to black (f303-311), black, then fade in from black (f313-317)
sunset picnic on the cliff edge; slow camera drift across the whole shot (compare 319/345 and 345/368: cliff and blanket edges doubled)
night, the leads seen from behind as dark shapes; a text caption types on over the sky from about f386
end card for the card game
